# Summary
One clear desired outcome.

## Problem
Reference verified current code/behavior.

## Why this matters
User or engineering impact.

## Current behavior
Observed behavior and baseline.

## Desired behavior
Observable outcome.

## Proposed implementation
Concrete direction; preserve the native stack.

## Relevant files / modules
Paths and boundaries.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Objectively verifiable outcome
- [ ] Regression/failure behavior tested

## Testing requirements
Exact success, failure and permission cases.

## Validation commands
Use existing AGENTS.md commands; explicitly scope any baseline blocker.

## Dependencies
None, or real issue links and completion requirements.

## Agent execution notes
Read AGENTS.md. No unrelated work, live data mutation, direct main push or automatic merge. Promote to automation:ready only after scope, validation and dependencies are settled.

## Definition of done
Criteria/tests pass and the linked PR is human-reviewed and merged.
